newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not fully established, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings current and fairly light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175 lbs ld 68.25.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Wednesdays close -
Slaughter steers and heifers not fully established.

Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs
Heifers -Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
